jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 철거멸실관리대장 lane `building-permit-demolition-loss` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0397): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_demolition_loss already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows in one bucket and append to main only the rows it has not held and a removal marker per row it no longer holds (each row keyed by its SHA-256) (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

assets.title: 건축인허가 철거멸실관리대장
assets.description: 철거·부분철거·멸실 신고마다 한 행: 지번, 철거멸실구분, 철거된 건물의 주용도·구조. 건물 수명 사건열의 끝이다. 제공자 키가 비어 행 글자의 SHA-256 이 키다. 원문 34칸 보존. 읽는 소비자(필지 by-PNU 패널)는 다음 PR 이라 그때까지 섬으로 둔다(루트 ADR-0397).

dependencies.description: 철거멸실관리대장(mart_kcy_07) 34칸을 행마다 새 행·사라진 행만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0397).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; a demolished building's 지번 often names a parcel since merged or split, which the consumer carries to the current pnu through the place-identity resolver (ADR-0288, ADR-0397)
